title: Derivation sheet
description: A sheet.toml file. It specifies how a request is transformed into a call to a partner API. See docs/format.md.

sheet.description: Slug for the workflow, usually the folder name.

version.description: Integer, incremented on every reviewed change. Evidence is keyed by this number.

request_schema.description: Path to the incoming request's JSON Schema, relative to this folder.

target_schema.description: Path to the partner request's JSON Schema, or an OpenAPI file with a pointer, e.g. `partner.yaml#/components/schemas/Quote`.

row.description: The rows of the sheet, one value each.

display.description: How the rendered sheet looks. Overrides the project-wide [display] in dsheets.toml. Never affects evaluation.

evidence.description: Initial state of the evidence switch in the rendered page.

send.description: Default "Sent to partner as". Often names the partner.

expression.description: A CEL expression over row IDs. Custom functions: round(x), years_between(a, b), today().

id.description: Unique, lowercase snake_case, stable across versions.

source.description: Input rows only: request.<path>, context.<name>, db.<table> or config.<key>.

type.description: Input rows only: the value type.

usage.description: Input rows only: R (required, the default) or S (situational, with `when`).

when.description: Input rows with usage S: when this input is required.

default.description: Input rows only: the value used when the input is missing.

uses.description: Derived rows: the row IDs this row uses, including any named in send.when.

formula.description: Rule: an expression over the rows in `uses`.

values.description: Lookups with one key: design-time values, keyed by the key value.

values_file.description: Lookups: a CSV in data/ whose header names the key columns, then one result column.

text.description: Rule: a plain-language description only. Reported as an open item.

reject.description: Conditions that reject the whole request.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions, reported by the validator.

table.description: Rule: a decision table over the rows in `uses`.

hit_policy.description: unique (default): exactly one rule may match. first: the first matching rule wins.

columns.description: Input row IDs, then "=>" for the result.

rows.description: Rules. Each cell is a literal, "-" for any value, or a comparison such as ">= 46". The last cell is the result.

lookup.description: Rule: a keyed lookup into a db or config source.

key.description: Row IDs that form the key, in order.

when.description: When true, the request is rejected.

send.description: Sends this row to the partner. A row without `send` is not sent.

field.description: Partner field. Dots nest objects, e.g. applicant.age.

usage.description: R: always required. S: situational, needs `when` and `otherwise`.

when.description: Usage S: when the field is required.

otherwise.description: Usage S: what to do when `when` is false.

map.description: Translates internal values to the partner's codes.
